title: Swap Code Blocks
description: Swap the two functions so 'process_data' comes before 'main'.
tips:
Swapping strategies:
1. Select 'main' (visual mode 'v' or 'x' for lines).
2. Delete it ('d').
3. Move to bottom.
4. Paste ('p').
5. Alternatively: Select, 'y' (yank), go to dest, 'p', go back, select original, 'd'.
